svg.title: The peoples of Genesis 10
svg.desc: A map of the Near East and eastern Mediterranean showing where the peoples named in the Table of Nations (Genesis 10) are thought to have lived, coloured by Noah's three sons, with an inset of Canaan and the route of Terah and Abram from Ur to Haran.

g.text: where they are thought to have lived
Name† in both Ham's and Shem's lines
Names whose place is unknown are not shown.
